_comment: Ratchet baseline for Tools/line_godot_slop.py. Values are the CURRENT metric for known offenders: they may only shrink. Do not raise an entry; split the class, extract a helper or flatten the branches instead. `complexity` is a function's branch score (1 + one point per if/elif/for/while/match in the body); `get_parent` counts upward tree walks per file, which may only go down - it is empty because no first-party file walks upward any more, so the default of 0 applies everywhere.
